findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added on UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). There is no no-arg overload on this class or its parents, so this change does not compile and the re-authentication skip cannot be built or shipped. The intended call is almost certainly isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()), which is already non-null in this branch.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys UI only filled when a user is already set
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled requires user != null, and both authenticate() (around line 115) and the error challenge() override (around line 137) now use that helper to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm. Previously fillContextForm ran whenever passkeys were enabled and the user was not yet selected — the conditional-UI / discoverable-credential login path. With the new check, the first username/password page (user still null) and invalid-credential re-renders that happen before context.setUser never receive challenge, rpId, or ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI. Re-authentication is covered, but ordinary passkey login on the unidentified form is regressed: the browser conditional UI has no WebAuthn parameters and cannot complete.
